hop_definition: hops is the minimum number of edge traversals the reference query needs: 1, 2, or 3 (three or more, with the exact count in traversals); global questions have no traversal count

judging.pairwise_ai: global questions, pairwise judged by the AI evaluator, labelled AI-assessed
judging.set_f1: set F1 against the Cypher reference

reference_answers: pending_v5; computed by deterministic Cypher after v5-enriched is loaded, before any system is tuned or run on the test questions
slot_sources: v4 organizations and topics; well-known AI concepts; entities absent from v5 are dropped and reported
written_without: any v5 graph, extraction output or language-model output
